headline: CLE @ CHW matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CLE 4.76 at CHW 4.38, with a projected total of 9.15. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (CLE +0.38, CHW +0.43), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +0.81, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Erick Fedde has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Sam Antonacci, Travis Bazzana, Patrick Bailey, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jacob Gonzalez, David Fry because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
